# Check for valid sort parameter and convert limit and offset to integers
def validate_params
  valid_sorts = ['ASC', 'DESC']
  sort = params[:sort].upcase if params[:sort].present?
  sort = 'DESC' unless valid_sorts.include?(sort)

  limit = params[:limit].to_i
  offset = params[:offset].to_i

  [limit, offset, sort]
end
